other_conditions: Parents must be residents of Haryana or have Haryana domicile, with at least one parent and the girl child residing in Haryana
The girl child must be registered at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or Health Department at birth
The birth of the girl child must be registered and the child must have an Aadhaar number (parents' Aadhaar also acceptable at enrollment)
Immunization records must be attached with the application form
Beneficiary must be unmarried when she turns 18 to encash the membership certificate
Any change of address must be reported to the Women and Child Development Project Officer/District Programme Officer and Civil Surgeon concerned
If the beneficiary dies before turning 18, enrollment is cancelled and the invested funds are reclaimed
benefits_summary: Each eligible girl child receives a one‑time grant of ₹21,000 (or annual grants for certain cases) invested with LIC and payable when she turns 18, provided she remains unmarried.
documents_required: Self‑attested copy of the birth certificate
Aadhaar number of the child or of the parents
